# E0304: what a lens produces is not an instance of its target schema

What a lens produces is an instance of its target schema. Checked at bind time
with the input standing for any instance of the source, this lens writes a
string where the target declares an int, whatever the input. When the totality
checker runs it names the mapping at fault (E0366); this is what remains when it
does not, as under SkipBuggyChecks here. CUE's account is in the detail.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a: int
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: "one"
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0304]: the result of lens 0.1->0.0 is not an instance of schema 0.0
  --> lineage.cue:20:3
   |
 6 |                 a: int
   |                    --- also here
...
20 |         result: {
   |         ^^^^^^
21 |             a: "one"
   |                ----- here
   |
   = detail: lenses."0.1->0.0".result.a: conflicting values "one" and int (mismatched types string and int)
```
